stem: Throughout the selection “Tiptoeing Scientists,” which idea about tiny frogs does the author highlight?

options.label: A
options.text: Scientists are finding tiny frogs throughout the mountain ranges of the world.

options.label: B
options.text: Researchers locate tiny frogs by their bold and unique coloring.

options.label: C
options.text: Tiny frogs can be very difficult for scientists to capture.

options.label: D
options.text: Tiny frogs have poisonous skin that helps to protect them.
